```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(lavaan)


alpha <- 0.05         
power_target <- 0.9  
loss_rate <- 0.1      
n_items <- 22        

n_cronbach <- function(alpha_expected = 0.9, alpha_min = 0.8,    
                       power_target = 0.9, loss_rate = 0.1){
  z <- qnorm(power_target)
  n0 <- (z^2 * (1 - alpha_expected)) / (alpha_expected - alpha_min)^2 + 2
  ceiling(n0 / (1 - loss_rate))
}


n_icc <- function(icc_expected = 0.9, icc_min = 0.8,
                  power_target = 0.9, alpha = 0.05,
                  loss_rate = 0.1){
  z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  z_power <- qnorm(power_target)
  n0 <- ((z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (1 - icc_min)^2) /
        (icc_expected - icc_min)^2
  ceiling(n0 / (1 - loss_rate))
}


n_cfa <- function(n_min = 50, n_max = 600, n_items = 22,
                  lambda = 0.5, n_rep = 500,
                  loss_rate = 0.1){

  model <- paste0("F =~ ", paste0("item", 1:n_items, collapse = " + "))
  n_seq <- seq(n_min, n_max, 10)

  power_rmsea <- numeric(length(n_seq))
  power_cfi   <- numeric(length(n_seq))

  for(i in seq_along(n_seq)){
    n_i <- n_seq[i]
    rmsea_ok <- 0
    cfi_ok <- 0
    valid <- 0

    for(r in 1:n_rep){

      F <- rnorm(n_i)
      dat <- sapply(1:n_items, function(j)
        lambda * F + rnorm(n_i, sd = sqrt(1 - lambda^2)))
      dat <- as.data.frame(dat)
      colnames(dat) <- paste0("item", 1:n_items)

      fit <- try(cfa(model, data = dat, std.lv = TRUE), silent = TRUE)

      if(!inherits(fit, "try-error")){
        if(lavInspect(fit, "converged")){
          fm <- fitMeasures(fit, c("rmsea", "cfi"))
          rmsea_ok <- rmsea_ok + (fm["rmsea"] < 0.05)
          cfi_ok   <- cfi_ok   + (fm["cfi"]  > 0.95)
          valid <- valid + 1
        }
      }
    }

    if(valid > 0){
      power_rmsea[i] <- rmsea_ok / valid
      power_cfi[i]   <- cfi_ok   / valid
    } else {
      power_rmsea[i] <- 0
      power_cfi[i]   <- 0
    }
  }

  ok <- n_seq[power_rmsea >= 0.9 & power_cfi >= 0.9]
  if(length(ok) == 0) return(NA)

  ceiling(min(ok) / (1 - loss_rate))
}

analysis <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("CFA", "Cronbach", "Test-retest ICC"),
  n_unadjusted = NA,
  n_adjusted = NA
)

analysis$n_unadjusted[analysis$Analysis == "Cronbach"] <-
  n_cronbach(loss_rate = loss_rate)
analysis$n_adjusted[analysis$Analysis == "Cronbach"] <-
  n_cronbach(loss_rate = 0)

analysis$n_unadjusted[analysis$Analysis == "Test-retest ICC"] <-
  n_icc(loss_rate = loss_rate)
analysis$n_adjusted[analysis$Analysis == "Test-retest ICC"] <-
  n_icc(loss_rate = 0)

analysis$n_unadjusted[analysis$Analysis == "CFA"] <-
  n_cfa(loss_rate = loss_rate)
analysis$n_adjusted[analysis$Analysis == "CFA"] <-
  n_cfa(loss_rate = 0)

print(analysis)

```
